Convergence curve: trial number vs separation value (Line)\n * 2. Trial state markers: COMPLETE (green circle), PRUNED (gray cross), FAIL (red triangle)\n * 3. Best trial highlight: green star ReferenceDot\n * 4. Hover info: trial number, value, state, duration, datetime\n * \n * Data Structure Analysis:\n * interface Trial {\n *   number: number;\n *   value: number | null;  // separation score\n *   state: 'COMPLETE' | 'PRUNED' | 'FAIL';\n *   datetime_start: string;\n *   datetime_complete: string | null;\n *   duration: number | null;\n *   params: Record<string, number | string | boolean>;\n * }\n * \n * Technical Selection:\n * - Recharts ComposedChart (Line + Scatter overlay)\n * - Line: Only connect COMPLETE trials to show convergence trend\n * - Scatter: All trials with state-based styling\n * - ReferenceDot: Mark best trial (highest separation)\n * \n * STEP 2 - REVIEW: Edge Cases & Type Safety\n * ------------------------------------------\n * Edge Cases Identified:\n * 1. Empty trials array → Show friendly message\n * 2. All trials PRUNED/FAIL → No convergence line, only scatter\n * 3. Trial.value === null → Filter out from Line, show in Scatter with special marker\n * 4. Single trial → No trend line (need min 2 points)\n * 5. 1000+ trials → Performance concern, use useMemo for data processing\n * \n * Type Safety:\n * - Filter null values before rendering Line\n * - Safe datetime parsing (fallback to \"N/A\")\n * - Handle missing duration (null → \"N/A\")\n * \n * Error Handling:\n * - Return early if !data || data.length === 0\n * - Graceful degradation for incomplete trial data\n * \n * STEP 3 - OPTIMIZE: Visual Consistency & Performance\n * ----------------------------------------------------\n * Performance:\n * - useMemo to process chart data (filter, sort, mark best trial)\n * - useMemo to find best trial\n * - Avoid inline functions in render (pre-calculate data)\n * \n * Visual Consistency:\n * - Colors match global scheme:\n *   - COMPLETE: #10b981 (green, same as MetricsPanel good values)\n *   - PRUNED: #6b7280 (gray, neutral)\n *   - FAIL: #ef4444 (red, same as MetricsPanel bad values)\n *   - Best trial star: #10b981 (green)\n * - Consistent formatting: 4 decimals for separation, ISO datetime\n * \n * Code Reuse:\n * - CustomTooltip pattern from StabilityChart\n * - formatValue utility for null/NaN handling\n * \n * UX Improvements:\n * - Legend explains state markers\n * - Best trial tooltip shows \"Best Trial: #X\"\n * - Duration shown in seconds with 2 decimals\n * - Datetime shown in readable format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)\n */\n\n'use client';\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport {\n  ComposedChart,\n  Line,\n  Scatter,\n  XAxis,\n  YAxis,\n  CartesianGrid,\n  Tooltip,\n  Legend,\n  ResponsiveContainer,\n  ReferenceDot,\n} from 'recharts';\nimport type { Trial, TrialSummary } from '@/lib/types';\nimport { ExportButton } from './ExportButton';\nimport { OptimizationHistoryTooltip } from './CustomTooltip';\n\ninterface OptimizationHistoryChartProps {\n  data: Trial[] | TrialSummary[];\n  taskId?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Format value with null/NaN/Infinity handling\n */\nconst formatValue = (value: number | null | undefined, decimals: number = 4): string => {\n  if (value == null || isNaN(value) || !isFinite(value)) {\n    return 'N/A';\n  }\n  return value.toFixed(decimals);\n};\n\n\n/**\n * OptimizationHistoryChart Component\n * \n * Displays Optuna optimization progress:\n * - Line chart showing convergence of COMPLETE trials\n * - Scatter plot showing all trials colored by state\n * - Best trial marked with green star\n */\nexport const OptimizationHistoryChart: React.FC<OptimizationHistoryChartProps> = ({\n  data,\n  taskId = 'unknown',\n  className = '',\n}) => {\n  const safeData = data ?? [];\n\n  // PERFORMANCE: useMemo to process chart data\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => {\n    return safeData.map((trial) => ({\n      ...trial,\n      // For Line: only COMPLETE trials with non-null values\n      lineValue: trial.state === 'COMPLETE' && trial.value != null ? trial.value : null,\n      // For Scatter: all trials\n      scatterValue: trial.value,\n    }));\n  }, [safeData]);\n\n  // PERFORMANCE: useMemo to find best trial\n  const bestTrial = useMemo(() => {\n    const completedTrials = safeData.filter((t) => t.state === 'COMPLETE' && t.value != null);\n    if (completedTrials.length === 0) return null;\n\n    return completedTrials.reduce((best, current) => {\n      return (current.value ?? -Infinity) > (best.value ?? -Infinity) ? current : best;\n    });\n  }, [safeData]);\n\n  // Attach bestValue to chart data for tooltip highlighting\n  const chartDataWithBest = useMemo(() => {\n    return chartData.map((item) => ({\n      ...item,\n      bestValue: bestTrial?.value,\n    }));\n  }, [chartData, bestTrial]);\n\n  // Calculate Y-axis domain (with 10% padding)\n  const yDomain = useMemo(() => {\n    const values = safeData.filter((t) => t.value != null).map((t) => t.value as number);\n    if (values.length === 0) return [0, 1];\n\n    const min = Math.min(...values);\n    const max = Math.max(...values);\n    const padding = (max - min) * 0.1;\n\n    return [min - padding, max + padding];\n  }, [safeData]);\n\n  if (safeData.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      <div className={`glass-panel rounded-xl p-6 ${className}`}>\n        <h3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100 mb-4\">\n          Optimization History\n        </h3>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-400\">\n          No optimization history data available.\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div \n      id=\"optimization-history-chart\"\n      className={`glass-panel rounded-xl p-6 ${className}`}\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\n        <h3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100\">\n          Optimization History\n        </h3>\n        <ExportButton\n          elementId=\"optimization-history-chart\"\n          chartName=\"OptimizationHistory\"\n          taskId={taskId}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={400}>\n        <ComposedChart\n          data={chartDataWithBest}\n          margin={{ top: 10, right: 30, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}\n        >\n          <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray=\"3 3\" stroke=\"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)\" />\n          <XAxis\n            dataKey=\"trial_number\"\n            label={{ value: 'Trial Number', position: 'insideBottom', offset: -5 }}\n            stroke=\"#64748b\"\n          />\n          <YAxis\n            domain={yDomain}\n            label={{ value: 'Separation', angle: -90, position: 'insideLeft' }}\n            stroke=\"#64748b\"\n            tickFormatter={(value) => value.toFixed(2)}\n          />\n          <Tooltip content={<OptimizationHistoryTooltip />} />\n          <Legend\n            wrapperStyle={{ paddingTop: '20px' }}\n            iconType=\"circle\"\n            formatter={(value) => {\n              const labels: Record<string, string> = {\n                lineValue: 'Convergence Trend (COMPLETE)',\n                COMPLETE: 'Complete Trials',\n                PRUNED: 'Pruned Trials',\n                FAIL: 'Failed Trials',\n              };\n              return labels[value] || value;\n            }}\n          />\n\n          {/* Convergence Line: Only COMPLETE trials */}\n          <Line\n            type=\"monotone\"\n            dataKey=\"lineValue\"\n            name=\"lineValue\"\n            stroke=\"#60a5fa\"\n            strokeWidth={2}\n            dot={false}\n            connectNulls={false}\n            isAnimationActive={false}\n          />\n\n          {/* Scatter: All trials colored by state */}\n          <Scatter\n            name=\"COMPLETE\"\n            dataKey=\"scatterValue\"\n            data={chartDataWithBest.filter((t) => t.state === 'COMPLETE')}\n            fill=\"#34d399\"\n            shape=\"circle\"\n          />\n          <Scatter\n            name=\"PRUNED\"\n            dataKey=\"scatterValue\"\n            data={chartDataWithBest.filter((t) => t.state === 'PRUNED')}\n            fill=\"#64748b\"\n            shape=\"cross\"\n          />\n          <Scatter\n            name=\"FAIL\"\n            dataKey=\"scatterValue\"\n            data={chartDataWithBest.filter((t) => t.state === 'FAIL')}\n            fill=\"#fb7185\"\n            shape=\"triangle\"\n          />\n\n          {/* Best Trial Marker */}\n          {bestTrial && (\n            <ReferenceDot\n              x={bestTrial.trial_number}\n              y={bestTrial.value}\n              r={10}\n              fill=\"#34d399\"\n              stroke=\"rgba(255,255,255,0.4)\"\n              strokeWidth={2}\n              ifOverflow=\"extendDomain\"\n            />\n          )}\n        </ComposedChart>\n      </ResponsiveContainer>\n\n      {/* Summary Stats */}\n      <div className=\"mt-4 grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-sm\">\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Total Trials</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100\">\n            {safeData.length}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Complete</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-emerald-400\">\n            {safeData.filter((t) => t.state === 'COMPLETE').length}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Pruned</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-400\">\n            {safeData.filter((t) => t.state === 'PRUNED').length}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Failed</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-rose-400\">\n            {safeData.filter((t) => t.state === 'FAIL').length}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {bestTrial && (\n        <div className=\"mt-4 bg-emerald-400/10 border border-emerald-400/30 rounded-lg p-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <span className=\"text-2xl\">⭐</span>\n            <div>\n              <div className=\"font-semibold text-emerald-200\">\n                Best Trial: #{bestTrial.trial_number}\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"text-sm text-emerald-300\">\n                Separation: {formatValue(bestTrial.value)}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/frontend/src/components/results/ParameterImportanceChart.tsx","messages":[{"ruleId":"react-hooks/exhaustive-deps","severity":1,"message":"The Horizontal bar chart: parameter importance ranking\n * 2. Sort by importance (descending)\n * 3. Color by significance_level: 高度顯著(green), 顯著(yellow), 不顯著(gray)\n * 4. Show importance percentage labels on bars\n * 5. Hover info: parameter, importance, p_value, effect_size, significance_level\n * \n * Data Structure Analysis:\n * interface ParamImportance {\n *   parameter: string;\n *   importance: number;  // 0-1 range\n *   significance_level: string;  // \"高度顯著\" | \"顯著\" | \"不顯著\"\n *   p_value: number;\n *   effect_size: number;\n * }\n * \n * Technical Selection:\n * - Recharts BarChart with layout=\"horizontal\"\n * - XAxis: importance (0-1, format as percentage)\n * - YAxis: parameter names (type=\"category\")\n * - Bar: Fill color based on significance_level\n * - CustomLabel: Display importance percentage on bars\n * \n * STEP 2 - REVIEW: Edge Cases & Type Safety\n * ------------------------------------------\n * Edge Cases Identified:\n * 1. Empty array → Show friendly message\n * 2. All importance === 0 → Show warning (optimization ineffective)\n * 3. Long parameter names (>20 chars) → Truncate with tooltip\n * 4. 20+ parameters → Chart too tall, set max height with scroll\n * 5. Single parameter → Still show bar (valid edge case)\n * \n * Type Safety:\n * - importance guaranteed 0-1 by backend\n * - significance_level string validation (use getSignificanceLevel utility)\n * - Handle missing fields gracefully\n * \n * Error Handling:\n * - Return early if !data || data.length === 0\n * - Validate significance_level mapping\n * \n * STEP 3 - OPTIMIZE: Visual Consistency & Performance\n * ----------------------------------------------------\n * Performance:\n * - useMemo to sort data by importance (descending)\n * - useMemo to calculate dynamic chart height\n * - Avoid inline color mapping (pre-define color map)\n * \n * Visual Consistency:\n * - Colors match getSignificanceLevel() utility:\n *   - \"高度顯著\": #10b981 (green, p < 0.01)\n *   - \"顯著\": #eab308 (yellow, 0.01 <= p < 0.05)\n *   - \"不顯著\": #9ca3af (gray, p >= 0.05)\n * - Consistent formatting: importance as percentage (XX.X%)\n * \n * Code Reuse:\n * - CustomTooltip pattern from OptimizationHistoryChart\n * - formatValue utility for null/NaN handling\n * \n * UX Improvements:\n * - Parameter names shown in full on Y-axis (no truncation, chart adjusts height)\n * - Hover tooltip shows exact p-value and effect size\n * - Legend explains significance levels\n * - Grid lines for easier reading\n */\n\n'use client';\n\nimport React, { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport {\n  BarChart,\n  Bar,\n  XAxis,\n  YAxis,\n  CartesianGrid,\n  Tooltip,\n  Legend,\n  ResponsiveContainer,\n  Cell,\n  LabelList,\n} from 'recharts';\nimport type { ParamImportance } from '@/lib/types';\nimport { ExportButton } from './ExportButton';\nimport { ParameterImportanceTooltip } from './CustomTooltip';\n\ninterface ParameterImportanceChartProps {\n  data: ParamImportance[];\n  taskId?: string;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Importance level color mapping (by rank)\n */\nconst getImportanceColor = (rank: number, total: number): string => {\n  const percentage = rank / total;\n  if (percentage <= 0.3) return '#34d399'; // Top 30% - emerald\n  if (percentage <= 0.7) return '#fbbf24'; // Middle 40% - amber\n  return '#64748b'; // Bottom 30% - slate\n};\n\n\n/**\n * Custom label to show percentage on bars\n */\nconst CustomLabel = (props: unknown) => {\n  const { x, y, width, value } = props;\n  const percentage = (value * 100).toFixed(1);\n\n  return (\n    <text\n      x={x + width + 5}\n      y={y + 12}\n      fill=\"#cbd5e1\"\n      fontSize={12}\n      fontWeight={500}\n      textAnchor=\"start\"\n    >\n      {percentage}%\n    </text>\n  );\n};\n\n/**\n * ParameterImportanceChart Component\n * \n * Displays parameter importance ranking from Optuna FIS analysis:\n * - Horizontal bar chart sorted by importance (descending)\n * - Colored by significance level (green/yellow/gray)\n * - Shows percentage labels on bars\n */\nexport const ParameterImportanceChart: React.FC<ParameterImportanceChartProps> = ({\n  data,\n  taskId = 'unknown',\n  className = '',\n}) => {\n  const safeData = data ?? [];\n\n  // PERFORMANCE: useMemo to sort data by importance (descending)\n  const sortedData = useMemo(() => {\n    return [...safeData].sort((a, b) => b.importance - a.importance);\n  }, [safeData]);\n\n  // PERFORMANCE: useMemo to calculate dynamic chart height\n  const chartHeight = useMemo(() => {\n    // Each parameter needs ~50px height, min 300px, max 800px\n    return Math.max(300, Math.min(800, sortedData.length * 50));\n  }, [sortedData.length]);\n\n  // Check if all importance values are 0 (optimization ineffective)\n  const allZero = sortedData.every((param) => param.importance === 0);\n\n  if (safeData.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      <div className={`glass-panel rounded-xl p-6 ${className}`}>\n        <h3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100 mb-4\">\n          Parameter Importance\n        </h3>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64 text-slate-400\">\n          No parameter importance data available.\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div \n      id=\"parameter-importance-chart\"\n      className={`glass-panel rounded-xl p-6 ${className}`}\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\n        <h3 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100\">\n          Parameter Importance (FIS Analysis)\n        </h3>\n        <ExportButton\n          elementId=\"parameter-importance-chart\"\n          chartName=\"ParameterImportance\"\n          taskId={taskId}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {allZero && (\n        <div className=\"mb-4 bg-amber-400/10 border border-amber-400/30 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-amber-300\">\n          ⚠️ All parameters show 0% importance. This may indicate optimization issues or insufficient trials.\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={chartHeight}>\n        <BarChart\n          data={sortedData}\n          layout=\"horizontal\"\n          margin={{ top: 10, right: 60, left: 120, bottom: 10 }}\n        >\n          <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray=\"3 3\" stroke=\"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)\" />\n          <XAxis\n            type=\"number\"\n            domain={[0, 1]}\n            tickFormatter={(value) => `${(value * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}\n            label={{ value: 'Importance (%)', position: 'insideBottom', offset: -5 }}\n            stroke=\"#64748b\"\n          />\n          <YAxis\n            type=\"category\"\n            dataKey=\"parameter_name\"\n            width={110}\n            stroke=\"#64748b\"\n            tick={{ fontSize: 12 }}\n          />\n          <Tooltip content={<ParameterImportanceTooltip />} />\n          <Legend\n            wrapperStyle={{ paddingTop: '20px' }}\n            payload={[\n              { value: 'Top 30% (High Importance)', type: 'square', color: '#34d399' },\n              { value: 'Middle 40% (Medium)', type: 'square', color: '#fbbf24' },\n              { value: 'Bottom 30% (Low)', type: 'square', color: '#64748b' },\n            ]}\n          />\n\n          <Bar dataKey=\"importance\" radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}>\n            {sortedData.map((entry, index) => (\n              <Cell\n                key={`cell-${index}`}\n                fill={getImportanceColor(entry.rank, sortedData.length)}\n              />\n            ))}\n            <LabelList content={<CustomLabel />} />\n          </Bar>\n        </BarChart>\n      </ResponsiveContainer>\n\n      {/* Summary Stats */}\n      <div className=\"mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-sm\">\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Total Parameters</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-100\">\n            {sortedData.length}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">High Importance (Top 30%)</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-emerald-400\">\n            {Math.ceil(sortedData.length * 0.3)}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Low Importance (Bottom 30%)</div>\n          <div className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-slate-400\">\n            {Math.floor(sortedData.length * 0.3)}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Top 3 Most Important Parameters */}\n      {sortedData.length >= 3 && (\n        <div className=\"mt-4 bg-blue-400/10 border border-blue-400/30 rounded-lg p-3\">\n          <div className=\"font-semibold text-blue-200 mb-2\">\n            🏆 Top 3 Most Important Parameters\n          </div>\n          <ol className=\"list-decimal list-inside text-sm text-blue-300 space-y-1\">\n            {sortedData.slice(0, 3).map((param, index) => (\n              <li key={index}>\n                <span className=\"font-medium\">{param.parameter_name}</span>:{' '}\n                {(param.importance * 100).toFixed(1)}% (\n        <div className=\"rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-rose-200\">\n          {error}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* 交易對列表 */}\n      {!isLoading && */\n\nimport type { TrialSummary } from './types';\n\n/**\n * Flatten nested object to dot notation\n * Example: { params: { threshold: 0.5 } } → { 'params.threshold': 0.5 }\n */\nfunction prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key;\n\n    if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {\n      // Recursively flatten nested objects\n      Object.assign(flattened, flattenObject(value, newKey));\n    } else {\n      flattened[newKey] = value;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return flattened;\n}\n\n/**\n * Escape CSV field according to RFC 4180\n * - Wrap in quotes if contains // Still create file with header only\n      const header = 'trial_number,value,state,duration,datetime_complete\\r\\n';\n      const blob = new Blob([header], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });\n      downloadBlob(blob, `optimization_trials_${taskId}_${getTimestamp()}.csv`);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Flatten all trials to get all possible keys\n    const flattenedTrials = trials.map((trial) => flattenObject(trial));\n\n    // Get all unique keys (for CSV header)\n    const allKeys = new Set<string>();\n    flattenedTrials.forEach((trial) => {\n      Object.keys(trial).forEach((key) => allKeys.add(key));\n    });\n\n    // Sort keys for consistent column order\n    const sortedKeys = Array.from(allKeys).sort();\n\n    // Generate CSV header\n    const header = sortedKeys.map(escapeCSVField).join(',') + '\\r\\n';\n\n    // Generate CSV rows\n    const rows = flattenedTrials.map((trial) => {\n      return sortedKeys.map((key) => escapeCSVField(trial[key])).join(',');\n    }).join('\\r\\n');\n\n    // Combine header and rows\n    const csv = header + rows;\n\n    // Create Blob and download\n    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });\n    const filename = `optimization_trials_${taskId}_${getTimestamp()}.csv`;\n    downloadBlob(blob, filename);\n\n    console.log(`Exported ${trials.length} trials to ${filename}`);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Failed to export CSV:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Export chart as PNG image using html2canvas\n * \n * @param elementId - DOM element ID to capture\n * @param chartName - Chart name for filename\n * @param taskId - Task ID for filename\n */\nexport async function exportChartToPNG(\n  elementId: string,\n  chartName: element\n    const element = document.getElementById(elementId);\n    if (!element) {\n      throw new Error(`Element with id \"${elementId}\" not found`);\n    }\n\n    // Capture element as canvas\n from canvas'));\n        }\n      }, 'image/png');\n    });\n\n    // Download blob\n    const filename = `${chartName}_${taskId}_${getTimestamp()}.png`;\n    downloadBlob(blob, filename);\n\n HANDOFF_NOT_UPDATED: 使用者明示 read-only、禁改任何檔；未寫入 `handoffs/20260617-datasource-ff-assessment-codex.md`。

**架構評估報告: datasource + Feature Factory**

【問題1】多數據源是否能輕易達成：**不能。現有 codebase 有 adapter 雛形，但不是可直接接 Glassnode/CoinGecko/台股/美股的成熟資料源架構。**

核心原因是「能 fetch 欄位」不等於「能安全做量化特徵」。目前 `DataSourceAdapter` 介面只有 `name/market/available_fields/fetch/validate/get_last_timestamp`，有 `market` 屬性，但沒有交易日曆、發布延遲、PIT availability、頻率、調整價、公司行動、資料版本等語義：[base_adapter.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/base_adapter.py:19)。`create_feature_factory()` 只註冊 `CryptoSpotAdapter`，沒有依 config 動態載入 adapters：[factories.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/factories.py:232)。`DataSourceConfig.adapters` 存在但未接上 factory：[feature_config.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_config.py:18)。

具體缺口與風險：
- **P0 高風險：跨頻率資料合併會靜默丟資料或錯配語義。** `AdapterRegistry.fetch_aligned()` 對所有 adapter 結果做 `pd.concat(..., join="inner")`：[adapter_registry.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/adapter_registry.py:40)。鏈上日頻資料加到 1h OHLCV 時，只會保留日頻 timestamp 正好命中的 row；若 timestamp 不同，可能大量變空。這不是 PIT 對齊，也沒有 forward-fill with publication lag。
- **P0 高風險：股票日曆不支援。** `KlineStorageManager._validate_continuity()` 要求相鄰 timestamp 差值等於 timeframe 秒數：[kline_storage.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/DataExtraction/kline_storage.py:968)。這適合 24/7 crypto，不適合台股/美股週末、假日、半日市、停牌、盤前盤後。
- **P0 高風險：台股/美股必要資料語義缺失。** 沒看到除權息/拆股調整、漲跌停、停牌、交易 session、exchange timezone 的一等模型。這會直接污染 return、rolling、IC label。
- **P1 中高風險：資料源白名單仍偏 crypto。** `ConfigManager` 允許來源固定在 OHLCV、taker、funding/open_interest 等：[config_manager.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/config_manager.py:224)。外部 on-chain/macro/equity fundamental 欄位會被擋。
- **P1 中高風險：crypto 欄位耦合存在。** `CryptoSpotAdapter` required fields 包含 `taker_buy_volume/taker_ratio`：[crypto_spot_adapter.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/crypto_spot_adapter.py:75)。microstructure OFI 也直接依賴 taker 欄位或用 taker_buy_volume/volume fallback：[microstructure_indicators.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/atomic/microstructure_indicators.py:113)。
- **P1 中高風險：cross-sectional 是 BTC-relative，不是通用橫截面。** default `reference_symbol = "BTCUSDT"`：[feature_config.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_config.py:357)。multi-symbol worker 還硬把 reference cache 寫到 `("BTCUSDT", tf)`：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:4087)。

【問題2】Feature Factory 是否足夠做量化特徵研究：**對目前 crypto OHLCV/taker 單市場研究，功能已接近可用；對多市場/多資料源特徵研究，不足。**

已具備的能力：
- 七層 pipeline 清楚：L0 ingestion、L1 atomic、L2 derived、L3 rolling、L4 lag、L5 cross-sectional、L6 meta、L7 persist：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:192)。
- L3 rolling 使用 pandas rolling，基本是 causal trailing window：[rolling_aggregator.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/operators/rolling_aggregator.py:224)。
- Multi-TF 對齊有專門 `TimeframeAligner`，用 source close time 對 primary decision time 做 backward asof，明確避免 future leak：[tf_aligner.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/timeframe/tf_aligner.py:26)。
- IC-first 串接已存在：FF 先寫 L7 raw，再由 IC engine stream parquet groups，不必整體 concat：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:1996)、[ic_engine.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/Analysis/ic_engine.py:104)。`FeatureReader` 也支援 group streaming/column projection：[feature_reader.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_reader.py:41)。

主要疑慮：
- **P0：L6.5 預處理可能依設定變成全樣本非 causal。** winsorization 在 `causal_preprocessing=False` 時用全列 mean/std 或全列 quantile：[feature_preprocessor.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/preprocessing/feature_preprocessor.py:2689)。fracdiff 的 d 選擇若非 causal，也會用全 series 做 ADF decision：[feature_preprocessor.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/preprocessing/feature_preprocessor.py:3722)。做 IC/ML 前必須鎖定 causal 或 train-window calibration。
- **P0：IC selection 預設全樣本。** `_run_ic_first_pipeline_impl()` 沒有 selection_window 時設成 `0..len(label)`、`ic_first_full_window`：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:2048)。這適合研究掃描，不適合宣稱 OOS 無洩漏。
- **P1：L5 名稱叫 cross-sectional，但實作是單 symbol vs reference close 的 relative/beta/idiosyncratic momentum，不是真正同時間全 universe ranking/neutralization：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:1691)。**
- **P1：adapter-level 對齊弱於 multi-TF 對齊。** FF 的 timeframe 對齊是安全設計，但外部資料源先在 L0 被 `fetch_aligned()` inner join，沒有使用 `TimeframeAligner`。
- **P2：Layer 1-6 對 OHLCV+enabled_sources 大致泛用，但高階 atomic/microstructure 與 preset 仍偏 Binance crypto。** 標準 preset 直接放 `quote_volume/trades/taker_*`：[config_manager.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/config_manager.py:922)。

**Go / No-Go 建議**

- **對「現有 crypto Feature Factory → IC Gatekeeper」：Conditional GO。** 可以推進 IC Gatekeeper，但前置條件是：固定只用現有 crypto cache、明確標記為研究內樣本、IC selection 必須提供 train/validation selection_window 或 split_id、L6.5 要證明 causal/train-fit 安全，並跑一組真實 kline 的 PIT 對齊與 label 檢查。
- **對「Glassnode/CoinGecko/台股/美股接入後一樣跑 FF→IC」：NO-GO。** 先補資料源合約：source frequency、availability timestamp、publication lag、calendar/session、adjusted/raw price policy、symbol mapping、missing policy、PIT join policy。否則很容易得到看似漂亮但不可信的 IC。

建議前置任務順序：
1. 新增 `DataSourceAdapter` metadata contract：`frequency`, `calendar`, `timezone`, `availability_ts`, `publication_lag`, `asset_class`, `point_in_time_safe`。

**架構評估報告: datasource + Feature Factory**

【問題1】多數據源是否能輕易達成：**不能。現有 codebase 有 adapter 雛形，但不是可直接接 Glassnode/CoinGecko/台股/美股的成熟資料源架構。**

核心原因是「能 fetch 欄位」不等於「能安全做量化特徵」。目前 `DataSourceAdapter` 介面只有 `name/market/available_fields/fetch/validate/get_last_timestamp`，有 `market` 屬性，但沒有交易日曆、發布延遲、PIT availability、頻率、調整價、公司行動、資料版本等語義：[base_adapter.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/base_adapter.py:19)。`create_feature_factory()` 只註冊 `CryptoSpotAdapter`，沒有依 config 動態載入 adapters：[factories.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/factories.py:232)。`DataSourceConfig.adapters` 存在但未接上 factory：[feature_config.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_config.py:18)。

具體缺口與風險：
- **P0 高風險：跨頻率資料合併會靜默丟資料或錯配語義。** `AdapterRegistry.fetch_aligned()` 對所有 adapter 結果做 `pd.concat(..., join="inner")`：[adapter_registry.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/adapter_registry.py:40)。鏈上日頻資料加到 1h OHLCV 時，只會保留日頻 timestamp 正好命中的 row；若 timestamp 不同，可能大量變空。這不是 PIT 對齊，也沒有 forward-fill with publication lag。
- **P0 高風險：股票日曆不支援。** `KlineStorageManager._validate_continuity()` 要求相鄰 timestamp 差值等於 timeframe 秒數：[kline_storage.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/DataExtraction/kline_storage.py:968)。這適合 24/7 crypto，不適合台股/美股週末、假日、半日市、停牌、盤前盤後。
- **P0 高風險：台股/美股必要資料語義缺失。** 沒看到除權息/拆股調整、漲跌停、停牌、交易 session、exchange timezone 的一等模型。這會直接污染 return、rolling、IC label。
- **P1 中高風險：資料源白名單仍偏 crypto。** `ConfigManager` 允許來源固定在 OHLCV、taker、funding/open_interest 等：[config_manager.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/config_manager.py:224)。外部 on-chain/macro/equity fundamental 欄位會被擋。
- **P1 中高風險：crypto 欄位耦合存在。** `CryptoSpotAdapter` required fields 包含 `taker_buy_volume/taker_ratio`：[crypto_spot_adapter.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/adapters/crypto_spot_adapter.py:75)。microstructure OFI 也直接依賴 taker 欄位或用 taker_buy_volume/volume fallback：[microstructure_indicators.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/atomic/microstructure_indicators.py:113)。
- **P1 中高風險：cross-sectional 是 BTC-relative，不是通用橫截面。** default `reference_symbol = "BTCUSDT"`：[feature_config.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_config.py:357)。multi-symbol worker 還硬把 reference cache 寫到 `("BTCUSDT", tf)`：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:4087)。

【問題2】Feature Factory 是否足夠做量化特徵研究：**對目前 crypto OHLCV/taker 單市場研究，功能已接近可用；對多市場/多資料源特徵研究，不足。**

已具備的能力：
- 七層 pipeline 清楚：L0 ingestion、L1 atomic、L2 derived、L3 rolling、L4 lag、L5 cross-sectional、L6 meta、L7 persist：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:192)。
- L3 rolling 使用 pandas rolling，基本是 causal trailing window：[rolling_aggregator.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/operators/rolling_aggregator.py:224)。
- Multi-TF 對齊有專門 `TimeframeAligner`，用 source close time 對 primary decision time 做 backward asof，明確避免 future leak：[tf_aligner.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/timeframe/tf_aligner.py:26)。
- IC-first 串接已存在：FF 先寫 L7 raw，再由 IC engine stream parquet groups，不必整體 concat：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:1996)、[ic_engine.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/Analysis/ic_engine.py:104)。`FeatureReader` 也支援 group streaming/column projection：[feature_reader.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_reader.py:41)。

主要疑慮：
- **P0：L6.5 預處理可能依設定變成全樣本非 causal。** winsorization 在 `causal_preprocessing=False` 時用全列 mean/std 或全列 quantile：[feature_preprocessor.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/preprocessing/feature_preprocessor.py:2689)。fracdiff 的 d 選擇若非 causal，也會用全 series 做 ADF decision：[feature_preprocessor.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/preprocessing/feature_preprocessor.py:3722)。做 IC/ML 前必須鎖定 causal 或 train-window calibration。
- **P0：IC selection 預設全樣本。** `_run_ic_first_pipeline_impl()` 沒有 selection_window 時設成 `0..len(label)`、`ic_first_full_window`：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:2048)。這適合研究掃描，不適合宣稱 OOS 無洩漏。
- **P1：L5 名稱叫 cross-sectional，但實作是單 symbol vs reference close 的 relative/beta/idiosyncratic momentum，不是真正同時間全 universe ranking/neutralization：[feature_factory.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/feature_factory.py:1691)。**
- **P1：adapter-level 對齊弱於 multi-TF 對齊。** FF 的 timeframe 對齊是安全設計，但外部資料源先在 L0 被 `fetch_aligned()` inner join，沒有使用 `TimeframeAligner`。
- **P2：Layer 1-6 對 OHLCV+enabled_sources 大致泛用，但高階 atomic/microstructure 與 preset 仍偏 Binance crypto。** 標準 preset 直接放 `quote_volume/trades/taker_*`：[config_manager.py](/Users/louis/Desktop/quantitative_trading_system/momentum/FeatureEngineering/config_manager.py:922)。

**Go / No-Go 建議**

- **對「現有 crypto Feature Factory → IC Gatekeeper」：Conditional GO。** 可以推進 IC Gatekeeper，但前置條件是：固定只用現有 crypto cache、明確標記為研究內樣本、IC selection 必須提供 train/validation selection_window 或 split_id、L6.5 要證明 causal/train-fit 安全，並跑一組真實 kline 的 PIT 對齊與 label 檢查。
- **對「Glassnode/CoinGecko/台股/美股接入後一樣跑 FF→IC」：NO-GO。** 先補資料源合約：source frequency、availability timestamp、publication lag、calendar/session、adjusted/raw price policy、symbol mapping、missing policy、PIT join policy。否則很容易得到看似漂亮但不可信的 IC。

建議前置任務順序：
1. 新增 `DataSourceAdapter` metadata contract：`frequency`, `calendar`, `timezone`, `availability_ts`, `publication_lag`, `asset_class`, `point_in_time_safe`。
2. 把 `fetch_aligned()` 改成 PIT-aware source alignment，禁止跨頻率 inner join 默默截資料。
3. 加 equity calendar/adjustment layer，台股/美股先不要進現有 crypto continuity gate。
4. 移除 BTCUSDT hardcode，將 reference/universe/cross-section 定義從 config 明確傳入。
5. IC Gatekeeper 前強制 selection split，不允許預設 full-window 當可驗收的 OOS 結果。
